name: Agentic App Seed - Claritty Platform Template
description: Minimal template for building agentic apps that deploy to Claritty Platform. Optimized for Claude Code brainstorming and implementation workflow.

required_env_vars: CLARITTY_PLATFORM_URL + CLARITTY_AUTH_TOKEN — LLM proxy (required for real AI; heuristic fallback if unset)
metadata.tenancy: Per-user via the X-User-ID header (models.user_id); there is NO CLARITY_WORKSPACE_ID

guidelines.give_it_its_own_identity: This is a TEMPLATE. Keep the platform contract but COMPLETELY replace the template identity (palette+font in frontend/src/theme.css, the landing page Dashboard.tsx, the header logo in Layout.tsx, appName in app-meta.ts, and the example agent/workflow/trigger). First run `rm .claritty-seed-pristine`. The identity gate (scripts/check-not-template.mjs, also a Stop hook + `npm run check:identity`) blocks 'done' until you do. See IDENTITY.md.
guidelines.start_with_brainstorming: Always run /superpowers:brainstorming before implementing — include the Design Identity step (palette, type, landing page, app mark) AND the external-action/approval/definition-of-done steps
guidelines.integrations_when_needed: If the app reads from or acts on an external service, CHECK catalog/INDEX.md FIRST. ~33 services (Gmail, Slack, LinkedIn, X, HubSpot, Stripe, Notion, GitHub…) are built-in integrations with PLATFORM-MANAGED OAuth — declare the integration in intelligence.yaml#integrations, list its tools in the agent's tools[], and call them (or use ctx.integration(...)). You need NO API keys and write NO OAuth code; test locally with CLARITTY_FAKE_CREDS_<ID> (the REAL path, not a mock). When not connected, return a 409 connect-prompt — NEVER fake/simulate success. Only when a service is NOT in the catalog (e.g. reddit/g2/hn) use a custom read-only tool or clearly-labeled seed data. Infer the obvious platform if the user didn't name one, and confirm. See INTEGRATIONS.md.
guidelines.approval_pattern: If the app shouldn't act autonomously, model draft → approved → published|failed and an /approve endpoint that performs the action, with a widget approve quick-action. Don't auto-publish what a human should sign off on.
guidelines.scheduling_is_platform_owned: There is NO local scheduler. SCHEDULE_* triggers only fire on the Claritty platform. Locally, run workflows on demand (POST /api/workflows/{id}/execute); the widget updates only after a run. Still ship the trigger template.
guidelines.definition_of_done: Define one concrete end-to-end success sentence (app-config.json core_action.definition_of_done) and verify the value path: agent runs → workflow persists → widget shows real data → the real action happens or is labeled simulated.
guidelines.widget_first_design: Design widgets before full app pages - widgets are primary interface
guidelines.self_hosted: You host this app yourself (Docker). The only Claritty dependencies are the LLM (via claritty_sdk proxy) and the UI kit (@clarittyai/widget-toolkit). Don't delete the required env vars (DATABASE_URL, CLARITTY_PLATFORM_URL, CLARITTY_AUTH_TOKEN).
guidelines.ai_via_sdk: Call models ONLY through claritty_sdk.llm.get_llm_client — never a raw provider SDK or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
guidelines.schema_via_migrations: Change the DB schema with Alembic migrations (backend/alembic.ini), never ad-hoc create_all — so data is preserved.
guidelines.keep_api_contract_in_sync: frontend/src/lib/api.ts and backend/routes/app.py must agree (same paths, methods, response shapes).
guidelines.multi_tenancy_required: Every query holding user data MUST filter by the caller (X-User-ID header). There is no CLARITY_WORKSPACE_ID.
guidelines.three_widget_sizes: Apple HIG, three sizes only: Small 170×170, Medium 360×170, Large 360×360
guidelines.design_system: Use the semantic token SYSTEM (bg-card, text-accent, text-muted-foreground; never bare hex; no hover-scale; 44px touch targets, 12px min font) — but give THIS app its own look by overriding the brand VALUES in frontend/src/theme.css (token names stay, values are yours). Don't ship the seed's indigo defaults. See .claude/design-tokens.md + IDENTITY.md
